notes.zh: 一次性重要升级（迁移版）：主控、蓝牙模块升级到新版本，灯板统一为版本 2。App 改用新的控制协议，支持新版智能遥控器和小遥控器配对；马达蓝牙名称改为 SW-TM-XXXX；按住配对键时蜂鸣器一直响。以后的马达更新都在这个版本之后进行。
notes.en: One-time major update (migration): new firmware for the main controller and the Bluetooth module; the light board is unified to version 2. The app uses the new control protocol and supports pairing the new smart remote and the mini remote; the motor's Bluetooth name becomes SW-TM-XXXX; the buzzer sounds continuously while the pairing key is held. Future motor updates require this version.

caution.zh: 升级约需 10 分钟，期间不要按马达电源键。升级后请重新校准（指南针、转向）。智能遥控器要升级到新版本并重新配对后才能使用。
caution.en: The update takes about 10 minutes; do not press the motor's power key. Recalibrate afterwards (compass and steering). The smart remote works again only after it is updated and paired again.

notes.zh: 首个支持蓝牙在线升级的版本（测试版）。
notes.en: First version with Bluetooth online update (test build).

notes.zh:
• 设备信息页显示设备名称（升级时的蓝牙名称 SW-RM-XXXX）、硬件版本和软件版本
• 不再显示公司
notes.en:
• Device info shows the device name (the Bluetooth name used for updates, SW-RM-XXXX), hardware version and software version
• Company is no longer shown

caution.zh: 测试版，只用于验证 App 升级流程。
caution.en: Test build, only for verifying updates from the app.
